verdict.rationale: First-party docs list a 'Debug live web applications | Chrome' capability. This indicates Claude Code can debug running web apps through a Chrome integration. The evidence is only a single link-title mention, backed by generic 'build, debug, and ship' marketing, so the depth and any setup requirements of the capability are unclear. Missing for 10: documentation of how the Chrome connection works (setup, extension or tooling needed), specifics of the debugging actions (console, network, DOM inspection), supported browsers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
